messages:
dana: ok team, kicking off a protective v2 ramp for na-west-1. we need conservative steps and explicit rollback criteria. quiet window 45m.
ryan: copy. what's the step plan?
isabel: start 3% -> 10% -> 30% -> 60% over 10m checkpoints. pause if any of: 5xx > 0.4%, client-schema-errors > 0.5%, or pinned-tenant-errors > 2%.
dana: adding note that we should not alter header normalization behavior in this slice — keep header bytes untouched. call out in release notes.
mike: deploy-bot, please schedule first slice and run functional probes against legacy fallback too.
deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] slice start initiated by mike at 6877777777. target: na-west-1, initial traffic 3%.
isabel: probe scripts: 
```
# basic health
http GET https://api.na-west.redwood/v2/health  Accept: application/json
# validation for v2 schema
http GET https://api.na-west.redwood/v2/ping -H "Client-Version: v2" | jq '.schema == "v2"'
```
ryan: quick ops note: we'll keep debug logging for the slice for 90m and rotate at +2h.
dana: telemetry to watch: p50/p95 latency, 5xx, client-schema-errors, mobile-sdk-pinned-errors. posting runbook link: https://runbooks/redwood/v2-ramp-na-west
mike: deploy-bot reports initial canary ok after 90s, no 5xx. can we step to 10%?
deploy-bot: [traffic update] moved to 10% at 6877777890. probes: ok.
isabel: rolling averages show tiny bump in p95 for generation calls. not breaching thresholds. keeping an eye.
dryan: (typo) meant to say diana — ignore
ryan: saw ~0.12% client-schema-errors from a single tenant, investigating.
dana: good catch — is that tenant pinned?
ryan: no, not pinned. correlated with client library version 3.1.
isabel: if it stays below 0.5% continue. set a micro-alert to notify at 0.3%.
mike: deploy-bot, schedule next ramp in 8m if stable.
deploy-bot: [scheduled] next hop to 30% at 6877778260 unless paused.
ryan: starting to capture full request/response bodies for the offending tenant for 10 requests each side. will redact PII.
dana: reminder for release notes: mention that some older SDKs may still send legacy headers; we will route but recommend upgrade.
isabel: 8m check-in: metrics steady, client-schema-errors 0.15%, no pinned tenant issues. proceed to 30% in 2m.
mike: canary update executed: traffic at 30% at 6877778450. some backend latency noise but within SLO.
deploy-bot: [canary metrics] p95 generation latency +8% (expected), 5xx 0.03%, client-schema-errors 0.16%.
dana: keep the cordon in place for 1h and don't merge any user-facing header-change PRs.
isabel: flag for platform: we'll need a hotpatch plan if client-schema-errors trend toward 0.5% in next 20m.
ryan: capturing logs and will upload a short incident gist if we need rollback.
mike: operator handback planned at 6877779015 if stable. deploy-bot please annotate rollforward in release notes draft.
deploy-bot: [operator-handback] scheduled at 6877779015. rollforward note added to draft: "na-west v2 ramp: conservative slice, monitor SDK versions"
dana: great job. staying on call until handback. if any pinned tenant crosses 2% error, we immediately revert to previous slice and notify partners.
ryan: thanks team, keeping eyes.
isabel: all green so far. continuing monitoring.
